'''2002 NYC Mini-Open''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG tournament in New York City in 2002. [[Chris Wodicka]] went 2-1 with a [[Dark Side|Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Imperial Siege|ISB Operations]] list (''6th place Coruscant regionals''), with a loss by 15 to [[Brian Terwilliger]]'s Senate.<ref name="dt-23830">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23830 6th place Coruscant regionals], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 8 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23830/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23830/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009115058/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23830/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' between 6 and 8 June 2002<ref name="tr-d3713">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-06-ya-hott-kashyyyk-regionalsd3713/ ya-hott-kashyyyk-regionals], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 6 June 2002): "Next stop is the NYC Mini-Open. Hope to see some people there." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261025160406/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-06-ya-hott-kashyyyk-regionalsd3713/ Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dt-23830" />{{Mystery|question=On what day was the 2002 NYC Mini-Open played|section=When was the 2002 NYC Mini-Open, and where did Scott Lingrell play his NYC deck?|type=date}}
* '''Site:''' New York City
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
